name: 5bills
description: Agents and hooks for careful research and writing in Obsidian, plus a few quality-of-life plugins.

plugins.name: review
plugins.description: Reviewers that report and never rewrite: audit (does the logic hold), critic (how the prose reads), reader (what an outsider can't follow) and haeden (a deep audit against the HAEDENISM method).

plugins.name: vault
plugins.description: Keeps an Obsidian research vault honest: research with sources, scribe for notes, librarian for structure, docs for clean exports, and a hook that makes source folders read-only.

plugins.name: simulated-actors
plugins.description: Pre-mortem a plan by simulating the people who must say yes (investors, customers, regulators, hires) from researched profiles: /panel for predictions, /actor for live rehearsal.

plugins.name: journal
plugins.description: Logs every prompt and reply to a daily raw log, flags days with no journal entry, and writes the entry with /journal. /interview builds a profile so Claude knows who it works for.

plugins.name: read-aloud
plugins.description: Reads each reply aloud with Microsoft Edge neural voices (edge-tts), skipping code, tables and URLs. A new prompt silences the old reply; /read-aloud toggles it.

plugins.name: vitals
plugins.description: A band above the prompt with context fill, the 5-hour usage limit and its reset countdown, and session cost, coloured from the active Claude Code theme.
